propositions: Current command syntax is split across reusable argparse parsers, imperative argv loops, 54 hand-maintained help files, and 22 intercept descriptions, causing drift between runtime parser, help text, and documentation.

Establish a single-source argparse factory protocol and registry that produces deterministic, byte-current generated help and package documentation before routing transitions off the compatibility execution ladder.
Parser migrations must capture production-path test oracles and maintain argv accept/reject parity, diagnostics, stream handling, and exit-code behavior atomically with runtime handler switchover.

Generate committed package-help and grouped-overview artifacts from registered factories; top-level routing recognizes only global config tokens, command identity, first-token help forms, and unknown commands.
